groups.label: Hydrangea mass
groups.blurb: Saturated blue and deep violet hydrangeas forming the dense gradient body of the floor arrangement.

items.role: Royal blue hydrangea balls — the vivid blue core of the blue-to-violet gradient.
Deep violet hydrangeas carrying the palette from blue into purple.

groups.label: Line flowers & accent blooms
groups.blurb: Tall larkspur spikes and round accent roses lifting colour through the green foliage.

items.role: Blue larkspur spikes stretching the blue tone upward through the arrangement.
Purple larkspur adding violet height beside the blue spikes.
Warm yellow Austin roses dotting bright accents among the blue and violet.
Soft pink Austin roses warming the lower edge of the arrangement.
Small violet ball chrysanthemums echoing the purple hydrangeas in tight clusters.
Light pink ranunculus adding soft layered petals near the base.

groups.label: Foliage & texture
groups.blurb: Grey-green foliage and fine trailing grass softening the structure between the blooms.

items.role: Grey-green eucalyptus foliage threading through the flowers.
Fine trailing air grass (fountain-grass effect) draping along the outer edge.
